 Attorney General Uthmeier to hold press conference at FIU regarding Raúl Castro ‘arrest warrant' 
 The news conference will be held at 10 a.m. 
 By NBC6 • 
 Published October 18, 2026 • 
 Updated on October 18, 2026 at 9:00 pm 
 BOOKMARKER 
 The NBC6 South Florida News streaming channel plays local South Florida news 24 hours a day, seven days a week. 
 Attorney General James Uthmeier will hold a news conference at Florida International University on Monday regarding an "arrest warrant" for former Cuban leader Raúl Castro.
 The news conference will be held at 10 a.m. 
 Watch NBC6 free wherever you are
   WATCH HERE 
 Specific details on the news conference remain limited.

 Raúl Castro charged with murder in Brothers to the Rescue shootdown 
 The news conference comes months after Castro was indicted by the United States  on May 20 for his alleged role in the 1996 downing of two planes operated by the Miami-based exile group Brothers to the Rescue.
 The indictment charges Castro and five others - Lorenzo Alberto Perez-Perez, Emilio Jose Palacio Blanco, Jose Fidel Gual Barzaga, Raul Simanca Cardenas, and Luis Raul Gonzalez-Pardo Rodriguez - with multiple charges: four counts of murder, two counts of destruction of aircraft, and conspiracy to kill U.S. nationals.
 Castro, now 95, was Cuba's defense minister at the time of the shootdown. The five others charged were pilots allegedly involved in the operation.
 A previous report included Gov. Ron DeSantis in the announcement. However, the event was coordinated by and will be led by Attorney General James Uthmeier. 
 NBC6 will be covering the event.
